before_observation: Each positive invocation first compares the complete first-query 5003-row map/schema, then fails the native-route assertion. Subsequent queries inside a failed invocation are not reached. Two retained-route/catalog controls per release/JDK pass.

native_runtime_qualification.method: Fresh release Rust core qualification includes independent sort-based string/Boolean-extrema oracles, sliced/independent NULL masks, all-NULL/empty arrays, scalar arrays, output ownership, and standard Display/truncation/padding formatting oracles with shared sliced validity.

profile.method: Five-second native process sample of the initial BOOLEAN pair after two seconds of startup; inclusive sampled frames are not elapsed-time percentages.
profile.observation: The initial generic extremum includes 1243 sampled zip frames. One of eight pilot bulk cells loses to stock and actual previous. A typed Boolean specialization combines packed value bitmaps with OR for greatest and AND for least, unions NULL validity independently, shares identity input bitmaps and handles absorbing scalar constants without expanding each scalar per row. Fresh qualification reruns both extrema and the complete core after this shared change.

limitations: This bounded ASCII proof does not replace Java UTF-16/cached source STRING ordering or dynamic-trim semantics; broad source-representation issue stays open.
Prepared results do not imply universal complete-job acceleration. All slower tiny/full-job cells and independent stock variability remain.

One qualification run was interrupted after a DECIMAL folded-literal bulk loss; all completed cells remain with their original encoder provenance. Incomplete process output is not presented as a complete trial.
